verdict.rationale: First-party docs say requests can be grouped into collections with nested subfolders (hoppscotch-docs-20, hoppscotch-docs-37), and the README promises organized collections and folders reusable with a single click (hoppscotch-gh-11). Collection-level headers/auth (hoppscotch-docs-4), OpenAPI tags imported as folders (hoppscotch-docs-15), and CLI collection runs with JUnit reports (hoppscotch-docs-8, hoppscotch-docs-9) strengthen the organize-and-rerun workflow. Community feedback notes limits: only one workspace offline, no custom workspace data directory, and no saved responses (hoppscotch-comm-5). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of rerunning saved requests from collections, and offline multi-workspace support.
